title: Serialized final-integration window corrective assurance

authority.basis: Operator-directed bounded development-orchestration correction within the ratified Parallel Development / Main-Head Churn Remediation programme.

post_decision_adversarial_finding.defect: The profile admission barrier treated OVC merge readiness being in_progress as sufficient proof of successful lane acquisition; the readiness acquisition step could fail on stale main while profile assurance still proceeded.
correction: Profile admission independently rechecks current main before checkout/test selection.
Required-check admission independently rechecks current main before canonical Python jobs.
Both admission routes prove exact PR-head ancestry against the admitted base before expensive assurance.
The original fail-closed readiness guards remain unchanged.

warnings: GitHub runner emitted the existing Node 20 deprecation warning for actions/checkout@v4; it was forced to Node 24 and did not affect assurance.

rollback: Revert only the final-integration admission handshakes and expanded hold semantics, restoring the prior PDC v1 readiness-lane timing while preserving the lane identity, historical evidence and the fail-closed stable-main guard.
delegated_rationale: The corrected exact-head candidate passed profile, canonical unittest, pytest-unittest parity, runner parity and merge readiness while the serialized lane held current main stable; the adversarial status-only admission race was reproduced, corrected and re-proved; no reserved authority delta or blocking review remains.
